sources.title: Clor overview
sources.locator: Multiplex agents; local and cloud; Mac app
sources.finding: Browser workspace and macOS app run the official Claude Code and Codex CLIs with the user subscription or API key, across own machines or hosted runners, with review and phone follow-up.

sources.title: Understand spaces
sources.finding: A space combines an agent, repository, sandbox, panes and configuration. Separate spaces isolate checkouts/process trees; the runner reconciles intended state.

sources.title: Parallel agent work
sources.finding: Separate spaces have independent files/branches. Tabs inside one space share the working tree.

sources.title: Shared memory
sources.locator: Search prior work; durable notes; capture
sources.finding: Memory indexes sessions; wiki notes persist decisions. Capture can be disabled per space.

sources.title: Teams and permissions
sources.finding: Teams own collaborative resources with User, billing and admin roles.

sources.title: Work with your Team
sources.finding: Admins invite teammates and assign roles; permitted resources are shared.

sources.title: Manage secrets
sources.finding: Secrets are referenced by name at runtime; scopes distinguish personal and Team values.

sources.title: Install Clor
sources.finding: CLI installs on macOS/Linux; Windows runs inside WSL2 with Docker Desktop integration.

sources.title: CLI overview
sources.finding: CLI has singular command groups, logfmt/JSON/JSONL output and API-key profiles with Team context.

sources.title: Hosted runners
sources.finding: Managed cloud runner creation has readiness state; destruction permanently removes the runner.

sources.title: GitHub integration
sources.finding: Connected GitHub supports repositories, pull requests and Git authentication; clor webgit serve opens repository work.

sources.title: Private Docker
sources.finding: Private Docker requires privileged outer containers, has per-space volumes retained across stop/recreate and documented degraded resource enforcement. It is not hostile-workload isolation.

sources.title: Execution boundary
sources.finding: Sandbox adds container isolation; a space without sandbox runs on the host.

sources.title: Clor pricing
sources.finding: No subscription; free control plane, unlimited Teams/spaces/configurations. Prepaid credits fund paid services; hosted runners $0.30–$4.95 per started hour.

sources.title: Clor privacy policy
sources.finding: Processes service inputs/outputs; does not train on work; primary store US; secrets encrypted, API secrets hashed; deletion request within 30 days with legal retention exceptions.

sources.title: Base image definition
sources.finding: Pinned toolchains include Claude/Codex, code-server, Playwright, language tools and Docker. Tool installation alone does not enforce tests or deployment.

sources.title: Container entrypoint
sources.finding: Argument commands exec under gosu space user. Managed path best-effort updates CLI then execs clor space daemon as root; child privilege behavior is inside closed daemon.

sources.title: Space skill
sources.finding: Product skill instructs upstream agent to create independent spaces, preflight configuration and verify lifecycle, credential and tab readiness. This is prompt-level delegation, not native coordinator enforcement.
